<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Snack Attack – Ad v2</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Lilita+One&family=Baloo+2:wght@600;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--page:#FFF7E0;--ink:#4A2410;--brown:#8E463F;--orange:#FBA665;--cream:#F6EBAD;--yellow:#FCD47C;--red:#D92B25;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--page:#2A140A}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--page:#2A140A}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0}
body{background:var(--page);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;font-family:'Baloo 2','Trebuchet MS',sans-serif}
#fit{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:12px;flex:none}
#stage{transition:background .8s;width:1280px;height:720px;position:absolute;left:0;top:0;transform-origin:0 0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);overflow:hidden}
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;transition:opacity .45s;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 70px;gap:50px}
.scene.on{opacity:1}
#bg{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden}.blob{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(50px)}.b1{width:620px;height:620px;background:#FFF7E0;opacity:.7;left:-120px;top:-160px;animation:d1 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.b2{width:560px;height:560px;background:#D92B25;opacity:.28;right:-140px;bottom:-200px;animation:d2 17s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.b3{width:420px;height:420px;background:#FCD47C;opacity:.8;left:45%;top:30%;animation:d3 11s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes d1{to{transform:translate(520px,260px) scale(1.2)}}@keyframes d2{to{transform:translate(-560px,-240px)}}@keyframes d3{to{transform:translate(-300px,200px) scale(.8)}}.fl{position:absolute;bottom:-130px;animation:rise linear infinite}@keyframes rise{to{transform:translateY(-920px) rotate(var(--r))}}
.scene>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
.h{font-family:'Lilita One','Arial Black',sans-serif;line-height:.95;margin:0}
.photo{width:520px;height:520px;flex:none;border-radius:50% 46% 52% 48%/48% 52% 46% 50%;overflow:hidden;border:10px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:14px 14px 0 var(--ink);transform:scale(.6) rotate(-8deg);opacity:0}
.photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transform:scale(1.15)}
.scene.on .photo{animation:pop .7s cubic-bezier(.2,1.4,.4,1) .1s forwards}
.scene.on .photo img{animation:zoom 6s linear forwards}
@keyframes pop{to{transform:scale(1) rotate(0);opacity:1}}
@keyframes zoom{to{transform:scale(1)}}
.txt{flex:1}
.name{font-size:92px;color:var(--ink);transform:translateX(-60px);opacity:0}
.sub{font-size:30px;font-weight:800;color:var(--brown);margin-top:10px;opacity:0}
.prices{display:flex;gap:20px;margin-top:34px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tag{background:var(--red);color:#FFF7E0;border:6px solid var(--ink);border-radius:26px;padding:6px 30px 0;text-align:center;box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--ink);transform:scale(0);font-family:'Lilita One',sans-serif}
.tag small{display:block;font-size:26px;font-family:'Baloo 2',sans-serif;font-weight:800;line-height:1}
.tag b{font-size:84px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.05}
.scene.on .name{animation:slide .6s ease-out .3s forwards}
.scene.on .sub{animation:fade .6s ease-out .6s forwards}
.scene.on .tag{animation:tagpop .5s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1) forwards}
.scene.on .tag:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.8s}.scene.on .tag:nth-child(2){animation-delay:1s}.scene.on .tag:nth-child(3){animation-delay:1.2s}
@keyframes slide{to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
@keyframes fade{to{opacity:1}}
@keyframes tagpop{from{transform:scale(0) rotate(-12deg)}to{transform:scale(1) rotate(-3deg)}}
.flip{flex-direction:row-reverse}
.ribbon{position:absolute;top:50px;right:60px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--yellow);font-family:'Lilita One',sans-serif;font-size:34px;padding:8px 26px 2px;border-radius:12px;transform:rotate(6deg) scale(0)}
.scene.on .ribbon{animation:tagpop 0.5s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1) 1.6s forwards}
.logo{width:460px;height:auto;flex:none;transform:scale(.4);opacity:0}
.scene.on .logo{animation:pop .8s cubic-bezier(.2,1.4,.4,1) forwards}
.big{font-size:130px}
.drinks{display:flex;gap:40px;flex:none}
.cup{text-align:center}
.cup .photo{width:310px;height:310px;border-width:8px;box-shadow:10px 10px 0 var(--ink)}
.cup .h{font-size:42px;margin-top:22px}
.cup .tag{display:inline-block;margin-top:10px;transform:rotate(-3deg) scale(0)}
.scene.on .cup:nth-child(2) .photo{animation-delay:.5s}
.scene.on .cup:nth-child(2) .tag{animation-delay:1.4s}
.close{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:12px;padding:18px 50px;overflow:hidden}
.top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px}
.top svg{width:118px;height:auto;flex:none}
.top .h{font-size:38px}
.top p{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:26px;font-weight:800;color:var(--brown)}
.grid{flex:1;min-height:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.t{background:#FFF7E0;border:5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px)}
.t img{width:100%;height:0;flex:1 1 0;min-height:0;object-fit:cover}
.t div{padding:4px 12px 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:6px;font-weight:800;font-size:22px;line-height:1.1;height:46px}
.t b{font-family:'Lilita One',sans-serif;font-weight:400;font-size:30px;color:var(--red);white-space:nowrap}
.scene.on .t{animation:slide .45s ease-out forwards}
.info{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center}.info span{background:var(--ink);color:var(--yellow);font-weight:800;font-size:25px;line-height:1.3;padding:3px 22px 0;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap}
#pl{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:6;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:60px 26px 20px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.8));color:#fff;font:800 28px 'Baloo 2',sans-serif;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
#pl.show{opacity:1}
#pl button{background:none;border:0;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;padding:9px;flex:none;margin:0}
#pl button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
#pl button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff}
#pl svg{width:100%;height:100%;fill:#fff}
#pl input[type=range]{accent-color:#fff;cursor:pointer;margin:0}
#sk{flex:1;height:8px}#vl{width:110px;flex:none;height:8px}
#tm{white-space:nowrap}
#bar{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;height:8px;background:var(--red);width:0;z-index:5}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.fl,.blob{animation:none}.scene.on *{animation-duration:.01s!important;animation-delay:0s!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute" aria-hidden="true"><defs>
<symbol id="logo" viewBox="0 0 400 440">
<polygon fill="#FBA665" stroke="#4A2410" stroke-width="7" stroke-linejoin="round" points="200,8 238,52 292,30 304,86 362,96 338,148 384,186 332,218 350,274 292,276 276,330 224,306 200,350 176,306 124,330 108,276 50,274 68,218 16,186 62,148 38,96 96,86 108,30 162,52"/>
<g fill="#FCD47C" stroke="#4A2410" stroke-width="7" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="112" y="70" width="28" height="110" rx="8"/><rect x="148" y="40" width="28" height="140" rx="8"/><rect x="186" y="22" width="28" height="158" rx="8"/><rect x="224" y="42" width="28" height="138" rx="8"/><rect x="260" y="72" width="28" height="108" rx="8"/></g>
<polygon fill="#D92B25" stroke="#4A2410" stroke-width="8" stroke-linejoin="round" points="98,172 302,172 280,310 120,310"/>
<g stroke="#4A2410" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M146,206 L184,222"/><path d="M254,206 L216,222"/></g>
<g stroke="#4A2410" stroke-width="6"><circle cx="164" cy="242" r="18" fill="#fff"/><circle cx="236" cy="242" r="18" fill="#fff"/></g>
<circle cx="168" cy="244" r="8" fill="#4A2410"/><circle cx="232" cy="244" r="8" fill="#4A2410"/>
<path d="M162,274 Q200,312 238,274 Z" fill="#fff" stroke="#4A2410" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<g fill="#fff" stroke="#4A2410" stroke-width="6"><ellipse cx="155" cy="324" rx="34" ry="13"/><ellipse cx="245" cy="324" rx="34" ry="13"/></g>
<text x="200" y="392" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Lilita One,Arial Black,sans-serif" font-size="66" textLength="388" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs" fill="#FCD47C" stroke="#4A2410" stroke-width="12" paint-order="stroke" stroke-linejoin="round">SNACK ATTACK</text>
<text x="200" y="428" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Baloo 2,sans-serif" font-weight="800" font-size="24" fill="#4A2410">Small Bites, Big Delight!</text>
</symbol><symbol id="fry" viewBox="0 0 60 80"><g fill="#FCD47C" stroke="#4A2410" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="12" y="6" width="9" height="34" rx="3"/><rect x="24" y="0" width="9" height="40" rx="3"/><rect x="36" y="8" width="9" height="32" rx="3"/></g><polygon points="6,36 54,36 48,76 12,76" fill="#D92B25" stroke="#4A2410" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="23" cy="52" r="3" fill="#4A2410"/><circle cx="37" cy="52" r="3" fill="#4A2410"/><path d="M24 60Q30 66 36 60" fill="none" stroke="#FFF7E0" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></symbol><symbol id="lemon" viewBox="0 0 60 60"><circle cx="30" cy="30" r="27" fill="#FCD47C" stroke="#4A2410" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="30" cy="30" r="21" fill="#FFF3B0"/><path d="M30 9V51M9 30H51M15 15L45 45M45 15L15 45" stroke="#FCD47C" stroke-width="3"/></symbol><symbol id="star" viewBox="0 0 60 60"><path d="M30 2L36 24L58 30L36 36L30 58L24 36L2 30L24 24Z" fill="#FFF7E0" stroke="#4A2410" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/></symbol></defs></svg>

<div id="fit"><div id="stage">
<div id="bar"></div>
<div id="pl"><button id="pp" aria-label="Play or pause"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path id="ppi" d="M6 5h4v14H6zM14 5h4v14h-4z"/></svg></button><span id="tm">0:00 / 0:40</span><input id="sk" type="range" min="0" max="1000" value="0" aria-label="Seek"><button id="mu" aria-label="Mute or unmute"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path id="mui" d="M3 9v6h4l5 5V4L7 9H3zm13.5 3A4.5 4.5 0 0 0 14 7.97v8.05A4.5 4.5 0 0 0 16.5 12z"/></svg></button><input id="vl" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="80" aria-label="Volume"><button id="fs" aria-label="Fullscreen"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 5h5v2H7v3H5zM14 5h5v5h-2V7h-3zM5 14h2v3h3v2H5zM17 14h2v5h-5v-2h3z"/></svg></button></div>
</div></div>

<script>
const IMG={plain:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',sweet:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',cheese:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',spud:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',chicken:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',tornado:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',straw:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',blue:'data:image/jpeg;base64,'};
const LOGO=c=>`<svg class="${c}" viewBox="0 0 400 440" role="img" aria-label="Snack Attack logo"><use href="#logo"/></svg>`;
const bgs=['--orange','--yellow','--cream','--orange','--yellow','--cream','--orange','--yellow','--cream'];
const S=[
{d:5,html:()=>LOGO('logo')+`<div class="txt"><p class="h big">HUNGRY?</p><p class="h" style="font-size:62px;color:var(--brown);margin-top:14px">ATTACK YOUR<br>CRAVINGS!</p><p class="sub" style="animation:fade .6s 1s forwards">Looking for something delicious?</p></div>`},
{d:4,img:'plain',n:'Plain Fries',s:'Crispy, golden, always fresh',p:[['Small','₱50'],['Medium','₱75'],['Large','₱90']]},
{d:4,img:'sweet',n:'Crispy Sweet Fries',s:'Sweet potato, extra crunch',p:[['','₱99']]},
{d:4,img:'cheese',n:'Cheese Fries',s:'Melty, cheesy, and loaded',p:[['','₱120']]},
{d:4,img:'spud',n:'Cheesy-Spud',s:'A whole potato smothered in cheese',p:[['','₱99']]},
{d:3,img:'tornado',n:'Tornado Potato',s:'Twisted, crunchy, on a stick',p:[['','₱81']]},
{d:5,img:'chicken',n:'Cheesy Chicken Fries',s:'Crispy chicken, stretchy cheese',p:[['','₱145']],rib:'MUST TRY!'},
{d:4,drinks:1},
{d:7,close:1}];
const MENU=[['plain','Plain Fries','₱50–90'],['sweet','Sweet Fries','₱99'],['cheese','Cheese Fries','₱120'],['spud','Cheesy-Spud','₱99'],['chicken','Cheesy Chicken','₱145'],['tornado','Tornado Potato','₱81'],['straw','Strawberry Lemonade','₱53'],['blue','Blue Lemonade','₱53']];
const stage=document.getElementById('stage'),fit=document.getElementById('fit'),bar=document.getElementById('bar');
const pat=`url("data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="150" height="150"><g fill="#D92B25" stroke="#4A2410" stroke-width="3"><path d="M20 40h36l-4 28H24z"/><path d="M60 100h36l-4 28H64z" transform="translate(30 -20)"/></g><g fill="#FCD47C" stroke="#4A2410" stroke-width="3"><path d="M26 40v-14M34 40v-20M42 40v-16M50 40v-12"/><path d="M96 80v-14M104 80v-20M112 80v-16M120 80v-12" transform="translate(0 0)"/></g></svg>')}")`;

const bg=document.createElement('div');bg.id='bg';bg.innerHTML='<i class="blob b1"></i><i class="blob b2"></i><i class="blob b3"></i>';
for(let i=0;i<18;i++){const k=['fry','fry','lemon','star'][i%4],w=k=='star'?30+Math.random()*30:44+Math.random()*50,f=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','svg');f.setAttribute('class','fl');f.setAttribute('viewBox',k=='fry'?'0 0 60 80':'0 0 60 60');f.style.cssText=`left:${Math.random()*1230}px;width:${w}px;height:${k=='fry'?w*1.33:w}px;animation-duration:${10+Math.random()*9}s;animation-delay:-${Math.random()*18}s;--r:${(Math.random()<.5?-1:1)*(120+Math.random()*240)}deg;opacity:${.55+Math.random()*.4}`;f.innerHTML=`<use href="#${k}"/>`;bg.appendChild(f)}
stage.prepend(bg);
const el=[];let acc=0;
S.forEach((s,i)=>{
 const d=document.createElement('section');d.className='scene'+(i%2?' flip':'');
 if(s.img)d.innerHTML=`<div class="photo"><img src="${IMG[s.img]}" alt="${s.n}"></div><div class="txt"><h2 class="h name">${s.n}</h2><p class="sub">${s.s}</p><div class="prices">${s.p.map(p=>`<div class="tag">${p[0]?`<small>${p[0]}</small>`:''}<b>${p[1]}</b></div>`).join('')}</div></div>${s.rib?`<div class="ribbon">${s.rib}</div>`:''}`;
 else if(s.drinks){d.style.justifyContent='center';d.classList.remove('flip');d.innerHTML=`<div class="drinks">${[['straw','Strawberry Lemonade'],['blue','Blue Lemonade']].map(c=>`<div class="cup"><div class="photo"><img src="${IMG[c[0]]}" alt="${c[1]}"></div><p class="h">${c[1]}</p><div class="tag"><b>₱53</b></div></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="txt" style="flex:none;width:380px"><p class="h" style="font-size:78px">FEELING THIRSTY?</p><p class="sub" style="animation:fade .6s .8s forwards">Refresh yourself. ₱53 each!</p></div>`}
 else if(s.close){d.classList.remove('flip');d.classList.add('close');d.innerHTML=`<div class="top">${LOGO('')}<div><p class="h">BIG FLAVOR, AFFORDABLE PRICES, ENDLESS CRAVINGS!</p><p>Satisfy your cravings today!</p></div></div><div class="grid">${MENU.map((m,k)=>`<div class="t" style="animation-delay:${.3+k*.18}s"><img src="${IMG[m[0]]}" alt="${m[1]}"><div><span>${m[1]}</span><b>${m[2]}</b></div></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="info"><span>📞 0926 663 6333</span><span>📍 Dela Cerna, Punta</span><span>🕙 Open 10 AM to 9 PM</span></div>`}
 else d.innerHTML=s.html();
 stage.appendChild(d);el.push([d,acc,acc+s.d]);acc+=s.d;
});
const TOTAL=acc;let t=0,playing=false,last=performance.now(),cur=-1;
function size(){const k=Math.min(innerWidth/1280,innerHeight/720);fit.style.width=1280*k+'px';fit.style.height=720*k+'px';stage.style.transform=`scale(${k})`}
addEventListener('resize',size);size();
function show(i){if(i===cur)return;cur=i;stage.style.background=`var(${bgs[i]})`;el.forEach(([d],k)=>{d.classList.remove('on');if(k===i){void d.offsetWidth;d.classList.add('on')}})}
function tick(n){const dt=(n-last)/1000;last=n;if(playing){t+=dt;if(t>=TOTAL){t=0;cur=-1}}
 const i=el.findIndex(([,a,b])=>t>=a&&t<b);show(Math.max(i,0));bar.style.width=(t/TOTAL*100)+'%';ui();requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
requestAnimationFrame(tick);
const pp=document.getElementById('pp');
pp.onclick=()=>{playing=!playing;icon();stage.classList.toggle('paused',!playing)};

let AC,mg,snd=true,nextT=0,step=0,timer;
const BPM=108,SP=60/BPM/4,ROOT=[38,43,36,33],CH=[[62,65,69,72],[59,62,65,67],[60,64,67,71],[57,60,64,67]],fq=m=>440*2**((m-69)/12);
function tone(m,t,d,ty,v,dt){const o=AC.createOscillator(),g=AC.createGain();o.type=ty;o.frequency.value=fq(m);if(dt)o.detune.value=dt;g.gain.setValueAtTime(v,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t+d);o.connect(g);g.connect(mg);o.start(t);o.stop(t+d)}
function kick(t){const o=AC.createOscillator(),g=AC.createGain();o.frequency.setValueAtTime(150,t);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(40,t+.12);g.gain.setValueAtTime(.9,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t+.2);o.connect(g);g.connect(mg);o.start(t);o.stop(t+.22)}
function noise(t,d,v,hp){const b=AC.createBuffer(1,Math.ceil(AC.sampleRate*d),AC.sampleRate),a=b.getChannelData(0);for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)a[i]=Math.random()*2-1;const s=AC.createBufferSource(),g=AC.createGain(),f=AC.createBiquadFilter();s.buffer=b;f.type='highpass';f.frequency.value=hp;g.gain.setValueAtTime(v,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t+d);s.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(mg);s.start(t)}
function sched(){while(nextT<AC.currentTime+.3){const s=step%16,bar=Math.floor(step/16)%4,t=nextT+(s%2?SP*.2:0);
 if(s%4==0)kick(nextT);
 if(s==4||s==12){noise(t,.16,.5,1200);noise(t+.012,.1,.3,2500)}
 if(s%2==0)noise(t,.05,.12,8000);if(s%4==2)noise(t,.14,.13,9000);
 if([0,3,6,8,10,13].includes(s)){const m=ROOT[bar]+([6,13].includes(s)?12:0);tone(m,t,SP*2,'triangle',.7);tone(m,t,SP*1.2,'sine',.5)}
 if([3,6,11,14].includes(s))CH[bar].forEach(m=>{tone(m,t,SP*1.3,'triangle',.07,-6);tone(m,t,SP*1.3,'square',.025,7)});
 const L={0:3,4:2,6:1,8:2,10:3,12:2};if(s in L)tone(CH[bar][L[s]]+12,t,SP*1.8,'sine',.12);
 nextT+=SP;step++}}
function startMusic(){try{if(!AC){AC=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();mg=AC.createGain();mg.gain.value=muted?0:vol*.6;mg.connect(AC.destination)}AC.resume();nextT=AC.currentTime+.05;step=0;clearInterval(timer);timer=setInterval(sched,100)}catch(e){}}
const PLAY='M8 5v14l11-7z',PAUSE='M6 5h4v14H6zM14 5h4v14h-4z',SPK='M3 9v6h4l5 5V4L7 9H3zm13.5 3A4.5 4.5 0 0 0 14 7.97v8.05A4.5 4.5 0 0 0 16.5 12z',MUTE='M3 9v6h4l5 5V4L7 9H3zM15.5 9.5 17 8l2 2 2-2 1.5 1.5-2 2 2 2L21 15l-2-2-2 2-1.5-1.5 2-2z';
let vol=.8,muted=false,drag=false,hid;const pl=document.getElementById('pl'),sk=document.getElementById('sk'),tm=document.getElementById('tm');
function icon(){document.getElementById('ppi').setAttribute('d',playing?PAUSE:PLAY);pl.classList.toggle('show',!playing)}
function applyVol(){if(mg)mg.gain.value=muted?0:vol*.6;document.getElementById('mui').setAttribute('d',muted||vol==0?MUTE:SPK)}
function fmt(s){s=Math.floor(s);return Math.floor(s/60)+':'+String(s%60).padStart(2,'0')}
function ui(){tm.textContent=fmt(t)+' / '+fmt(TOTAL);if(!drag)sk.value=t/TOTAL*1000}
document.getElementById('mu').onclick=()=>{ensureAudio();muted=!muted;applyVol()};
document.getElementById('vl').oninput=e=>{ensureAudio();vol=e.target.value/100;muted=false;applyVol()};
sk.oninput=()=>{t=sk.value/1000*TOTAL;cur=-1};
sk.onpointerdown=()=>{drag=true};sk.onpointerup=()=>{drag=false};
document.getElementById('fs').onclick=()=>{document.fullscreenElement?document.exitFullscreen():document.documentElement.requestFullscreen&&document.documentElement.requestFullscreen()};
stage.addEventListener('pointermove',()=>{pl.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(hid);hid=setTimeout(()=>{if(playing)pl.classList.remove('show')},2500)});
stage.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(!e.target.closest('#pl'))pp.click()});
function ensureAudio(){if(!AC)startMusic();else if(AC.state!=='running')AC.resume()}
addEventListener('message',e=>{if(e.data==='sa-wake')ensureAudio()});
['pointerdown','keydown','touchend'].forEach(ev=>addEventListener(ev,ensureAudio,{capture:true}));
playing=true;last=performance.now();icon();applyVol();startMusic();
pp.onclick=()=>{playing=!playing;icon();try{if(AC)playing?AC.resume():AC.suspend()}catch(e){}};

</script>
</body>
</html>
